{"summary":"Task `v5-routing-long-hard-2`: directed routing on 8 nodes. Return `order` as a permutation of 1..7; `values` and `files` must be empty. Start at depot 0 at time 0, visit each node once, and return to 0. No waiting; window bounds are inclusive. A time/window/budget is checked only once all travel rows it needs are revealed. No optimization objective; stage passes are provisional.

Latest checkpoint artifact: `{"files":[],"order":[6,1,2,3,4,5,7],"values":[]}`. Stage 4 candidate note says node 6 is visited at time 4 and all other nodes are included once; receipt and feedback were `public_pass` (9 checks). Earlier stage 3 candidate retained `[1,2,3,4,5,6,7]`, with receipt `public_pass` (7 checks). Older memory records stage 1/2 passes and feedback, all provisional.

Revealed travel costs (each list indexed by destination 0..7): from 0 `[0,8,6,3,9,3,4,4]`; from 1 `[3,0,3,2,1,6,1,7]`; from 2 `[7,6,0,6,7,6,9,2]`; from 3 `[7,1,4,0,8,7,3,1]`; from 4 `[7,6,7,6,0,2,6,7]`; from 5 `[2,7,1,8,3,0,5,3]`; from 6 `[7,4,1,4,1,8,0,9]`; from 7 `[4,4,5,7,8,5,6,0]`.

Revealed visit requirements: node 6 exactly at time 4; node 4 in inclusive window [5,6]; node 7 in inclusive window [12,15]. Current packet is stage 5 of 8, with 26 actions remaining. Later-stage requirements are not supplied; no candidate for stage 5 is shown. Supplied public dossier is empty; trial notes are unverified."}
